statement: The system shall reduce manual work involved in running model jobs while still providing experienced users with sufficient control when needed.

The system shall allow users to easily monitor jobs.
The system shall reliably handle the full job lifecycle from submit through stop.
The system shall reliably handle job restart.

The system shall enable users to trust the system to select appropriate resources for jobs.
The system shall allow users to override the system-selected resource and request a specific cluster when needed.
The primary users of the Model Manager are scientists and software engineers.

Software engineers may care more about scripted workflows.
Administrators would likely be responsible for keeping clusters available.
